items.title: Public Aircraft Operations—Manned and Unmanned
items.summary: This AC provides information to assist in determining whether government-owned or government-contracted manned and unmanned aircraft operations conducted within the territory of the United States are public or civil aircraft operations under the statutory definition of “public aircraft” in Title 49 of the United States Code (49 U.S.C.)

items.title: United States (U.S.) National Aviation Standard for the Very High Frequency Omnidirectional Radio Range (VOR)/Distance Measuring Equipment (DME)/Tactical Air Navigation (TACAN) Systems
items.summary: This Advisory Circular is issued to inform the aviation community of the establishment and content of the United States(U.

items.title: Aircraft Ground Handling, Servicing, and Marshalling
items.summary: This AC contains information and guidance for servicing, ground handling, and marshalling an aircraft.

items.title: FAA Quality Control System Certification Program
items.summary: Official FAA advisory circular: FAA Quality Control System Certification Program.

items.title: Status of Federal Aviation Regulations
items.summary: Official FAA advisory circular: Status of Federal Aviation Regulations.

items.title: Aviation Safety Reporting Program
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides guidance for the submission of reports under the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Aviation Safety Reporting Program (ASRP).

items.title: Voluntary Industry Distributor Accreditation Program with Change 1
items.summary: This AC describes a system for accrediting civil aircraft parts distributors based on voluntary industry oversight.

items.title: Voluntary Disclosure Reporting Program
items.summary: This AC provides information and guidance material that a regulated entity (RE) operating under Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) may use when voluntarily disclosing to the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) apparent violations of those FAA regulations listed in paragraph 2.

items.title: Integrating Helicopter and Tiltrotor Assets into Disaster Relief Planning
items.summary: Provides guidance to state and local emergency relief planners on integrating helicopters and tiltrotor aircraft into disaster relief planning efforts.

items.title: North American Free Trade Agreement and Specialty Air Services Operations
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides information and guidance for operators under the provisions of the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA) and operational guidance within the three Civil Aviation Authorities (CAA).

items.title: Event Planning Guide
items.summary: Describes acceptable methods for organizing the aviation community for all events, such as major sports events (auto racing, golf, etc.)

items.title: Use of Flight Deck Displays of Digital Weather and Aeronautical Information
items.summary: This AC provides guidance to flightcrew members and other airmen on the best practices for the use of data link to access Flight Information Services (FIS).

items.title: Air Medical Resource Management
items.summary: This AC provides guidance and information, which establish minimum guidelines for Air Medical Resource Management Training.

items.title: Towbar and Towbarless Movement of Aircraft
items.summary: This AC provides guidance for towbar and towbarless movement of aircraft and applies to all operators under Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) parts 91, 91 subpart K (part 91K), 121, 125, 129, and 135.

items.title: Selection of Cyclic Redundancy Code and Checksum Algorithms to Ensure Critical Data Integrity
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides information about the availability of resource material on digital data integrity.

items.title: Aircraft Certification Service Voluntary Disclosure Reporting Program
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides information and guidance to Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Aircraft Certification Service (AIR) Production Approval Holders (PAHs), Design Approval Holders (DAHs), and Organization Designation Authorization Holders (ODA Holders) who choose to voluntarily disclose apparent noncompliance with Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR).

items.title: The title is Best Practices for Airborne Software Development Assurance Using EUROCAE ED-12( ) and RTCA DO-178( )
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides information in the form of “best practices” and, as such, is not intended as guidance but rather as complementary information to ED-12C/DO-178C (and related documents) and AC 20-115D.

items.title: Flightcrew Member Certificate Verification Plan
items.summary: This AC provides information to Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) fractional ownership program managers operating under 14 CFR part 91 subpart K (part 91K) and 14 CFR part 119 certificate holders operating under 14 CFR parts 121 and 135, seeking approval of Operations Specification (OpSpec)/Management Specification (MSpec) A063, Flightcrew Member Certificate Verification Plan.

items.title: Best Practices for Management of Open Problem Reports (OPRs)
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides “best practices” for the management of open problem reports, and is intended to complement AC 20-189, Management of Open Problem Reports (OPRs).

items.title: Best Practices for Airborne Electronic Hardware Design Assurance Using EUROCAE ED-80( ) and RTCA DO-254( )
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides “best practices” for airborne electronic hardware (AEH) design assurance and, is intended to be complementary information to EUROCAE ED-80, Design Assurance Guidance for Airborne Electronic Hardware, RTCA DO-254, Design Assurance Guidance for Airborne Electronic Hardware, and AC 20-152A, Development Assurance for Airborne Electronic Hardware.

items.title: Avionics Human Factors Considerations for Design and Evaluation
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) identifies two reports that provide information in the form of “recommended practices” to increase awareness of human factors and facilitate the identification and resolution of human factors/pilot interface issues during the design and evaluation of avionics.

items.title: U.S. Agents for Service on Individuals with Foreign Addresses Who Hold or Apply for Certain Certificates, Ratings, or Authorizations
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides individuals with guidance on how to comply with Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) sections 3.301 through 3.303.

items.title: Notice of Proposed Rulemaking Distribution System
items.summary: This circular provides the public with information relative to the participation in the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) rulemaking process and the availability of Notices of Proposed Rulemaking.

items.title: Qualification Testing of Turbojet and Turbofan Engine Thrust Reversers
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides guidance for demonstrating compliance with Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) 33.97, Thrust reversers, and for certifying a thrust reverser for use with a turbojet or turbofan engine.

items.title: Approval of Propulsion Fuels, Additives, and Lubricating Oils
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides guidance applicable to adding fuels and oils as engine, aircraft, or auxiliary power unit (APU) operating limitations.

items.title: Certification and Operation of Amateur-Built Aircraft
items.summary: This Advisory Circular (AC) provides information about Title 14, Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) part 21, Certification Procedures for Products and Parts, § 21.191(g) for the purpose of operating amateur-built aircraft.

items.title: Approval and Use of Fuel System Icing Inhibitors (FSII)
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) describes an acceptable method to demonstrate compliance with Title 14, Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) §§ 23.2620(a)(1), 25.1583(b)(1), 27.1583(b)(1), 29.1583(b)(1), 33.7(b)(2), and 33.7(c)(2) regarding the requirements for the approval and use of Fuel System Icing Inhibitors (FSII) in engines and aircraft.

items.title: Aircraft Position Light and Anticollision Light Installations
items.summary: Sets forth acceptable means, but not the only means, of showing compliance with the Federal Aviation Regulations (FAR) applicable to installed position lights and anti-collision lights.

items.title: Technical Information Regarding Civil Aeronautics Manuals 1, 3, 4a, 4b, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 13, and 14
items.summary: Advises the public that policy information contained in the subject Civil Aeronautics Manuals may be used in conjunction with specific sections of the Federal Aviation Regulations.

items.title: Aircraft Propeller Maintenance
items.summary: Provides information and suggested procedures to increase service life and to minimize blade failures of metal propellers.

items.title: Placards for Battery-Excited Alternators Installed in Light Aircraft
items.summary: Sets forth an acceptable means of complying with placarding rules in Federal Aviation Regulations 23 and 27 with respect to battery excited alternator installations.

items.title: Substitute Technical Standard Order (TSO) Aircraft Equipment
items.summary: Sets forth an acceptable means for complying with rules governing aircraft equipment installations in cases involving the substitution of technical standard order equipment for functionally similar TSO approved equipment.

items.title: Hand Fire Extinguishers for Use in Aircraft
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) gives you guidance for the fire-fighting effectiveness, selection and safe-use of hand fire extinguishers in airplanes and rotorcraft.

items.title: Glass Fiber Fabric for Aircraft Covering
items.summary: Provides a means, but not the sole means, for acceptance of glass fiber fabric for external covering of aircraft structure.

items.title: Safetying of Turnbuckles on Civil Aircraft
items.summary: Provides information on turnbuckle safetying methods that have been found acceptable by the FAA during past aircraft type certification programs.

items.title: Exterior Colored Band around Exits on Transport Airplanes
items.summary: Sets forth an acceptable means, but not the only means, of complying with the requirement for a 2-inch colored band outlining exits required to be openable from the outside on transport airplanes.

items.title: Protection of Aircraft Fuel Systems Against Vapor Ignition Caused by Lightning
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides applicants with guidance for obtaining Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) approval of compliance pursuant to title 14, Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) 23.954, 27.954, and 29.954, Fuel system lightning protection.

items.title: Marking of TSO-C72b Individual Flotation Devices
items.summary: Outlines acceptable methods for marking individual flotation devices which also serve as seat cushions

items.title: Eligibility, Quality, & Identification of Aeronautical Replacement Parts
items.summary: Guidance for determining the quality, eligibility, and traceability of aeronautical parts and materials intended for installation on U.S. type-certificated products and articles.

items.title: Propeller Vibration and Fatigue
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides guidance and describes one method, but not the only method, for demonstrating compliance with §§ 23.907 and 25.907 of Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) for the evaluation of vibratory stresses on propellers installed on airplanes.

items.title: Airborne VHF Communication Equipment Installations
items.summary: Official FAA advisory circular: Airborne VHF Communication Equipment Installations.

items.title: Recommended Radiation Safety Precautions for Ground Operation of Airborne Weather Radar
items.summary: Sets forth recommended radiation safety precautions for ground operation of airborne weather radar.

items.title: Conspicuity of Aircraft Instrument Malfunction Indicators
items.summary: Provides design guidance information on methods of improving conspicuity of malfunction indication devices.

items.title: Dual Locking Devices on Fasteners
items.summary: Provides guidance and acceptable means, not the sole means, by which compliance may be shown with the requirements for dual locking devices on removable fasteners installed in rotorcraft and transport category airplanes.

items.title: Aircraft Ice Protection
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) tells type certificate and supplemental type certificate applicants how to comply with the ice protection requirements of Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) parts 23, 25, 27, 29, 33, and 35.

items.title: Aircraft Position and Anticollision Light Measurements
items.summary: Contains useful information concerning measurements for intensity, covering, and color of aircraft position and anti-collision lights.

items.title: Use of Manufacturers’ Maintenance Manuals
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) informs owners and operators about the usefulness of manufacturer’s maintenance manuals for servicing, repairing, and maintaining aircraft, engines, and propellers.

items.title: Guidelines on the Marking of Aircraft
items.summary: Provides revised guidelines on the marking of aircraft powerplant instruments and electronic displays (cathode ray tubes, etc.).

items.title: Digital Clock Installation in Aircraft
items.summary: Official FAA advisory circular: Digital Clock Installation in Aircraft.

items.title: Aircraft Tire Maintenance and Operational Practices with Change 1
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides recommended tire care and maintenance practices needed to assure the safety of support personnel and the continued airworthiness of aircraft.

items.title: General Guidelines for Measuring Fire-Extinguishing Agent Concentrations in Powerplant Compartments
items.summary: Describes the installation and use of a model GA-2A fire extinguisher agent concentration recorder in determining the distribution and concentration of fire-extinguishing agents when discharged in an aircraft powerplant compartment.

items.title: Revised Powerplant Engineering Report No. 3A Standard Fire Test Apparatus and Procedure (for Flexible Hose Assemblies)
items.summary: Announces the availability of the subject report.

items.title: Reciprocating Engine Power-Loss Accident Prevention and Trend Monitoring
items.summary: This AC discusses the circumstances surrounding engine power-loss accidents. It provides recommendations on how, through individual effort and consideration, those accidents can be prevented.

items.title: Aircraft Inspection for the General Aviation Aircraft Owner
items.summary: Describes techniques used in aircraft inspections. Designed to familiarize owner, pilots, student mechanics, and others with inspection procedures, it does NOT qualify an individual to make airworthiness determinations.

items.title: Composite Aircraft Structure
items.summary: This AC sets forth an acceptable means, but not the only means of showing compliance with the provisions of Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) parts 23, 25, 27, and 29 regarding airworthiness type certification requirements for composite aircraft structures involving fiber reinforced materials, e.g., carbon and glass fiber reinforced plastics.

items.title: Service Difficulty Reporting System (Air Operator/Air Agency/General Aviation/Unmanned Aircraft Systems)
items.summary: Describes FAA-prescribed and FAA-accepted service difficulty reporting methods for air operators, air agencies, general aviation, and unmanned aircraft systems.

items.title: Pilot Precautions and Procedures to be taken in Preventing Aircraft Reciprocating Engine Induction System and Fuel System Icing Problems
items.summary: Provides information pertaining to aircraft engine induction system icing and the use of fuel additives to reduce the hazards of aircraft operation that may result from the presence of water and ice in aviation gasoline and aircraft fuel systems.

items.title: Airborne Software Development Assurance Using EUROCAE ED-12( ) and RTCA DO-178( )
items.summary: This AC describes an acceptable means, but not the only means, for showing compliance with the applicable airworthiness regulations for the software aspects of airborne systems and equipment in type certification or TSO authorization.

items.title: Marking Aircraft Fuel Filler Openings with Color Coded Decals
items.summary: Discusses the conditions under which color coded decals may be used to comply with the requirements in FAR Parts 23, 25, 27, and 29 for marking fuel filler openings.

items.title: Emergency Evacuation Demonstration
items.summary: Sets forth acceptable means, but not the only means, of showing compliance with the Federal Aviation Regulations (FAR) applicable to required emergency evacuation demonstrations from airplanes certified to the requirements of SFAR 23, SFAR 41, Appendix A of Part 135, or Part 23, commuter category.

items.title: Fuel Drain Valves
items.summary: Provides an acceptable means, but not the only means, of compliance with the requirements of the FARs for positive locking of fuel drain valves in the closed position.

items.title: Nondirectional Beacon Frequency Congestion
items.summary: Recommends several actions that the user can take to alleviate problems of frequency congestion in the 190-535 kHz frequency range.

items.title: Anti-misfueling Devices: Their Availability and Use - Change 1
items.summary: Includes information relating to the Society of Automotive Engineers (SAE) standard dimensions for fueling ports now being incorporated during new aircraft production by all General Aviation Manufacturer’s Association member companies.

items.title: Avoiding or Minimizing Encounters with Aircraft Equipped with Depleted Uranium Balance Weights during Accident Investigations
items.summary: Provides information and guidance to individuals who come in contact with depleted uranium contained in aircraft control surfaces during accident investigations.

items.title: Water Ingestion Testing for Turbine Powered Airplanes
items.summary: Describes a method of demonstrating compliance with the requirements of the FAR concerning the ingestion of water from the runway/taxiway surface into the airspeed system, the engine, and essential auxiliary power unit air inlet ducts of turbine engine power unit air inlet ducts of turbine engine powered airplanes.

items.title: Water in Aviation Fuels
items.summary: Alerts the aviation community to the potential hazards of water in aviation fuels. Additionally, it outlines recommended procedures to prevent, detect, and eliminate water in the fuel systems of aircraft.

items.title: Use of Society of Automotive Engineers (SAE) Class H11 Bolts
items.summary: Provides guidance on the use of SAE Class H11 bolts in primary structure on all aircraft, including gliders and manned free balloons, and on aircraft engines and propellers.

items.title: Design Considerations for Minimizing Hazards caused by Uncontained Turbine Engine and Auxiliary Power Unit Rotor Failure
items.summary: Sets forth a method of compliance with the requirements of Sections 23.903(b)(1), 25.901(d) and 25.903(d)(1) of the FAR pertaining to design precautions taken to minimize the hazards to an airplane in the event of uncontained engine or auxiliary power unit rotor (compressor and turbine) failure and engine fan blade failures.

items.title: Airworthiness Approval of Traffic Alert and Collision Avoidance Systems (TCAS II) and Mode S Transponders
items.summary: Provides guidance material for the airworthiness and operational approval of Traffic Alert and Collision Avoidance Systems (TCAS II) and Mode S transponders.

items.title: Cockpit Noise and Speech Interference Between Crewmember
items.summary: Provides information about the relationship between flight crew members cockpit voice communication and cockpit noise levels.

items.title: Test Procedures for Maximum Allowable Airspeed Indicators
items.summary: Provides guidance concerning test procedures which may be used in showing compliance with the standards in technical standards orders C 46a.

items.title: Powerplant Installation and Propulsion System Component Fire Protection Test Methods, Standards, and Criteria
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides guidance for powerplant fire testing and recognizes the Society of Automotive Engineers (SAE) Aerospace Standard (AS) 6826, Powerplant Fire Test Standards, as an acceptable Means of Compliance (MoC) for demonstrating compliance to the applicable regulations specified in Appendix A.

items.title: Aircraft Electrical and Electronic System Lightning Protection
items.summary: This AC provides you, the applicant, with information and guidance on how you can protect aircraft electrical and electronic systems from the effects of lightning.

items.title: Airworthiness Approval of Positioning and Navigation Systems (Including Change 2)
items.summary: This revision adds minor clarifications and new guidance material based on issues and questions since revision ‘C’ was published.

items.title: Guidelines for Design Approval of Aircraft Data Link Communication Systems Supporting Air Traffic Services (ATS)
items.summary: This AC provides guidance material for applicants seeking an airworthiness approval for aircraft with an installed data link system intended to support air traffic services (ATS) data communication.

items.title: Airworthiness and Operational Approval of Digital Flight Data Recorder Systems with Change 1
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) contains changes to Appendix 3. This AC provides information on certification (design and installation) and continued airworthiness of digital flight data recorder systems (DFDRS).

items.title: Eligibility and Evaluation of U.S. Military Surplus Flight Safety Aircraft Parts, Engines, and Propellers
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides information and guidance for use in evaluating and determining the eligibility of U.S. military surplus flight safety critical aircraft parts (FSCAP), engines, and propellers for installation on Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) type-certificated products.

items.title: Installation, Inspection, and Maintenance of Controls for General Aviation Reciprocating Aircraft Engines
items.summary: Provides guidance regarding the inspection, maintenance, and installation of engine controls with emphasis on the airframe portion of these systems.

items.title: FAA Approval of Electrical Firing Cartridge Components in an Aircraft Fire Extinguishing or Suppression System
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides acceptable means for showing compliance with the requirements of title 14, Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) 23.1301, amendment 23-62 or earlier, 25.1301, 27.1301, and 29.1301 (herein, collectively, 2X.1301), Function and installation, with regard to fire extinguishing or suppression systems that contain electrical firing cartridge components.

items.title: Methodology for Dynamic Seat Certification by Analysis for Use in Parts 23, 25, 27, and 29 Airplanes and Rotorcraft
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) sets forth an acceptable means, but not the only means, for demonstrating compliance with title 14, Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) 23.562, 23.2270, 25.562, 27.562, and 29.562, as well as technical standard order (TSO) TSO-C127, TSO-C127a, TSO-C127b, and TSO-C127c.

items.title: Turbojet, Turboprop, Turboshaft, and Turbofan Engine Induction System Icing and Ice Ingestion
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides guidance for demonstrating compliance with the engine induction system icing and engine installation ice requirements of Title 14 Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) parts 23, 25, 27, 29, and 33.

items.title: Reusable Software Components
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides one acceptable means of compliance, but not the only means, for reusable software component (RSC) developers, integrators, and applicants to gain: • The Federal Aviation Administration’s (FAA) “acceptance” of a software component that may be only a part of an airborne system’s software applications and intended functions

items.title: Installation Guidance for Domestic Flight Information Service- Broadcast
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) supports the use of Flight Information Services-Broadcast (FIS-B) weather and other aeronautical data link products for enhanced situation awareness of flight conditions.

items.title: Airworthiness Approval of Satellite Voice (SATVOICE) Equipment Supporting Air Traffic Service (ATS) Communication
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides guidance on airworthiness approval for designers, manufacturers, and installers of Satellite Voice (SATVOICE) equipment supporting air traffic service (ATS).

items.title: Airworthiness Approval of Traffic Alert and Collision Avoidance Systems (TCAS II), Versions 7.0 & 7.1 and Associated Mode S Transponders
items.summary: We wrote this advisory circular (AC) to guide applicants seeking airworthiness approval for TCAS II version 7.1 (V7.1) certified to technical standard order (TSO) C119c, TSO-C119d or TSO-C119e, Traffic Alert and Collision Avoidance System (TCAS) Airborne Equipment, TCAS II with Hybrid Surveillance.

items.title: Development Assurance for Airborne Electronic Hardware
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) describes an acceptable means, but not the only means, for showing compliance with the applicable airworthiness regulations for the electronic hardware aspects of airborne systems and equipment for type certification or Technical Standard Order (TSO) authorization.

items.title: Acceptance of Aeronautical Data Processes and Associated Databases
items.summary: This AC describes an acceptable means, but not the only means, for showing compliance with the applicable airworthiness regulations for equipment with an installed aeronautical database.

items.title: Guide for Developing a Receiving Inspection System for Aircraft Parts and Materials
items.summary: This AC provides guidance and information for developing a receiving inspection system and for incorporation into a person’s existing receiving inspection system to help prevent the introduction of unairworthy articles into inventories.

items.title: Industry Documents To Support Aircraft Lightning Protection Certification
items.summary: a. This advisory circular (AC) recognizes several SAE Aerospace Recommended Practices (ARPs) and European Organization for Civil Aviation Equipment (EUROCAE)documents as acceptable methods for showing compliance with airworthiness regulations.

items.title: Aviation Databus Assurance
items.summary: a. This advisory circular (AC) is for aircraft and aircraft engine manufacturers anddesigners. We provide a means to gain Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) approval of your aviation databus by showing the databus design performs its intended function and satisfies the applicable airworthiness requirements when installed on an aircraft or aircraft engine.

items.title: How to Prepare Reliability Assessment Plans for Aircraft Systems and Equipment
items.summary: This AC shows you how to develop and use a reliability assessment plan. An assessment plan documents the controlled, repeatable processes for assessing the reliability of aircraft and engine electronic and electrical systems, including their electromechanical elements and equipment.

items.title: The Certification of Aircraft Electrical and Electronic Systems for Operation in the High-Intensity Radiated Fields (HIRF) Environment
items.summary: This AC provides guidance for a new type certificate (TC) or a change to an existing TC when the certification basis requires you to address the HIRF certification requirements of §§ 23.1308 (Amendment 23-57), 23.2520 (Amendment 23-65), 25.1317, 27.1317, or § 29.1317.

items.title: Onboard Recording of Controller Pilot Data Link Communication (CPDLC) In Crash Survivable Memory
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides guidance material for applicants seeking an airworthiness approval for aircraft with an installed Data Link Recording (DLR) system that records Controller Pilot Data Link Communications (CPDLC).

items.title: Aircraft Onboard Weight and Balance Systems
items.summary: This Advisory Circular (AC)gives manufacturers and installers an acceptable means of compliance to meet the installation, operation, and airworthiness requirements for aircraft onboard weight and balance systems (OBWBS)

items.title: Airworthiness Approval of Installed Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) Tags and Sensors
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides certification applicants with airworthiness guidance for installing passive, battery-assisted passive (BAP), and active radio frequency identification (RFID) tags and sensors on aviation products and equipment.

items.title: Displaying Geometric Altitude Relative to Mean Sea Level
items.summary: a. This advisory circular (AC) shows you how to gain a type certificate (TC), supplemental TC (STC), amended TC (ATC), amended supplemental TC (ASTC), or technical standard order (TSO) authorization for systems incorporating the presentation of geometric altitude relative to mean sea level (MSL) on electronic displays.

items.title: Designing and Demonstrating Aircraft Tolerance to Portable Electronic Devices
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) identifies RTCA Inc.1, document, DO-307B, or later FAA-accepted revision, Aircraft Design and Certification for Portable Electronic Device (PED) Tolerance, as an acceptable means for designing and demonstrating aircraft tolerance to potential electromagnetic interference from portable electronic devices (PEDs).

items.title: Airworthiness Approval of Automatic Dependent Surveillance - Broadcast OUT Systems
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides guidance for the installation and airworthiness approval of Automatic Dependent Surveillance - Broadcast (ADS-B) OUT systems in aircraft.

items.title: Issue Paper Process
items.summary: a. This advisory circular (AC) provides information on the use of issue papers and gives you guidance on your role in describing and tracking the resolution of significant technical, regulatory, and administrative issues derived from the issue paper process.

items.title: Airworthiness Approval of Enhanced Vision System, Enhanced Flight Vision System, and Combined Vision System Equipment
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides guidance for gaining airworthiness approval for enhanced vision systems in aircraft.
items.contentError: Offline text is omitted pending permission to redistribute incorporated copyrighted RTCA material. Read the official FAA publication.

items.title: Certification Guidance for Installation of Non-Essential, Non-Required Aircraft Cabin Systems & Equipment (CS&E)
items.summary: This AC provides the primary certification guidance on how to meet the airworthiness requirements for installation of non-essential, non-required aircraft cabin systems & equipment (CS&E).

items.title: Guidance for Certification of Military and Special Mission Modifications and Equipment for Commercial Derivative Aircraft (CDA)
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides guidance for the certification of commercial derivative aircraft (CDA).

items.title: Integrated Modular Avionics Development. Verification, Integration and Approval using RTCA/DO-297 and Technical Standard Order C153
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) shows you how to obtain Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) airworthiness approval for the development, verification, and integration of an integrated modular avionics (IMA) system for installation into an aircraft or engine.

items.title: Alternatives to RTCA/DO-178B for Software in Airborne Systems and Equipment
items.summary: On January 11, 1993, we, the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), published Advisory Circular (AC) 20-115B recognizing RTCA/DO-178B, Software Considerations in Airborne Systems and Equipment Certification, dated December 1, 1992, as a means, but not the only means, to seek FAA approval of airborne software.

items.title: Airworthiness Approval for ADS-B In Systems and Applications
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides guidance for the initial and follow-on installations of Automatic Dependent Surveillance – Broadcast (ADS-B) In systems supporting ground and airborne traffic applications.

items.title: Installation of Electronic Flight Bag Components
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides guidance material on the installation of electronic flight bag (EFB) components including aircraft connectivity provisions.

items.title: Development of Civil Aircraft and Systems
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) recognizes the Society of Automotive Engineers (SAE) Aerospace Recommended Practice (ARP) 4754A, Guidelines for Development of Civil Aircraft and Systems , dated December 21, 2010, as an acceptable method for establishing a development assurance process.

items.title: Controls for Flight Deck Systems
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides guidance for the installation and airworthiness approval of flight deck system control devices, from primarily a human factors perspective.

items.title: Service Bulletins Related to Airworthiness Directives and Indicating FAA Approval on Service Documents
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) presents best practices for drafting service bulletins (SB) related to an airworthiness directive (AD).

items.title: Design and Installation Guidance for an Airborne System for Non-Required Telecommunication Service in Non Aeronautical Frequency Bands
items.summary: A. In this advisory circular (AC), the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) recommends one way to gain airworthiness approval for an Airborne System for Non-Required Telecommunication (ASNRT) service equipment in the cockpit.

items.title: Flammability Testing of Aircraft Cabin Interior Panels After Alterations
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) describes acceptable methods to test aircraft cabin interior materials when new finishes are used on existing aircraft cabin interior panels, typically performed on supplemental type certificates (STC) or major alterations.

items.title: Certification Data Retention Agreements and Government Records
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) describes the procedures that you, domestic design approval applicants and design approval holders (DAHs), should follow when entering into a certification data retention agreement with the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA).

items.title: Approved Model List Supplemental Type Certificate (AML-STC)
items.summary: This advisorycircular(AC)providesguidelines and requirements to obtain approved model list (AML)supplemental typecertificate(STC).

items.title: Airworthiness Approval of Attitude Heading Reference System (AHRS) Equipment
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) supplements existing airworthiness approval guidance for attitude heading reference system (AHRS) articles approved under technical standard order (TSO)?

items.title: Airworthiness Approval for Aircraft Weather Radar Systems
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides guidance for the initial and follow-on airworthiness approval of aircraft weather radar systems meeting the latest revision of the Technical Standard Order (TSO)-C63, Airborne Weather Radar Equipment.

items.title: Laser Airworthiness Installation Guidance
items.summary: In this advisory circular (AC), we recommend one way to obtain Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) airworthiness approval for the installation of aircraft?

items.title: Guidance on Testing and Installation of Rechargeable Lithium Battery and Battery Systems on Aircraft
items.summary: This AC provides manufacturers and installers with an acceptable means, but not the only means, of compliance with §§ 23.2525, 25.1353, 27.1353, 29.1353, and additional commonly issued requirements related to the design, installation, operation, and maintenance of rechargeable lithium batteries and battery systems on aircraft.

items.title: Airworthiness Approval of Synthetic Vision Systems, Synthetic Vision Guidance Systems and Aircraft State Awareness Synthetic Vision Systems
items.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has consolidated all synthetic vision related guidance into this advisory circular (AC).
items.contentError: Offline text is omitted pending permission to redistribute incorporated copyrighted RTCA material. Read the official FAA publication.

items.title: Airworthiness and Operational Approval of Cockpit Voice Recorder Systems
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides guidance for gaining airworthiness approval for cockpit voice recorder (CVR) systems.

items.title: Compatibility of Changes to Type Design Installed on Aircraft

items.title: Use of Portable Electronic Devices Aboard Aircraft

items.title: Lengthy Tarmac Delays and Associated Airline/Airport Contingency Plans and Related Air Traffic Control Communications

items.title: Emergency Security Control of Air Traffic (ESCAT)

items.title: Flightcrew Member Rest Facilities

items.title: Fatigue Education and Awareness Training Program

items.title: Fitness for Duty

items.title: Operational Authorization of Aircraft Network Security Program

items.title: Operational Use of Radio Frequency Identification Systems Onboard Aircraft

items.title: Private Carriage Versus Common Carriage of Persons or Property

items.title: Assignment of Aircraft Call Signs and Associated Telephonies

items.title: Aircraft Weight and Balance Control

items.title: Air Transportation of Handicapped Persons

items.title: The Influence of Beards on Oxygen Mask Efficiency

items.title: Air Carrier First Aid Programs

items.title: Parts 121 and 135 Certification

items.title: Guidelines for Operational Approval of Windshear Training Programs

items.summary: This AC provides information and guidelines to Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) part 135 air carriers/operators to aid in the development of a Second in Command Professional Development Program (SIC PDP) which meets the requirements of part 135, § 135.99(c).

items.title: Part 135 Operator Aircraft Configuration Inspection
items.summary: This AC provides information concerning the placement of aircraft into service for Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) part 135 commuter and on demand operations.

items.title: Use of Noncertified Weather Observations in Noncontiguous States
items.summary: This AC provides information and recommendations to air carriers operating under the authority of Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) part 135 and in the noncontiguous States (i.e., Alaska or Hawaii) on the use of noncertified weather information in support of instrument approaches conducted under instrument flight rules (IFR) at airports without destination weather reporting approved by the National Weather Service (NWS) or the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA).

items.title: Small Propeller-Driven Air Taxi Airplanes that meet Sections 135.169 (formerly 135.144)
items.summary: Provides a summary of and information on small propeller-driven air taxi airplanes that comply with section 135.169(b) and may continue operations under FAR 135 with ten or more passenger seats.

items.title: Commercial Air Tour Operations Conducted Over National Parks and Tribal Lands
items.summary: This Advisory Circular (AC) contains information, directions, and procedures for obtaining operating authority for commercial air tour operations over national parks and tribal lands.

items.title: Recommended Aircraft Maintenance Practices for Commercial Air Tour Operators - Change 1 Included
items.summary: This AC describes maintenance practices that we, the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), recommend for aircraft that you, a commercial air tour operator, use to perform commercial air tours.

items.title: Supplemental Information for the Creation of Operating Procedures and Pilot Training Subjects Related to OpSpec/LOA B048
items.summary: This AC contains information pertinent to Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) part 136 subpart D.

items.title: Enhanced Flight Following Center (EFFC) for Commercial Air Tour Operators
items.summary: This AC was created in response to safety recommendations proposed by the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) as a response to an accident which occurred in the state of Alaska.

items.title: Certification Process for Agricultural Aircraft Operators
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) describes an acceptable means, but not the only means, for an agricultural aircraft operator to apply for an Agricultural Aircraft Operator Certificate under Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) part 137.

items.title: Part 141 Pilot Schools, Application, Certification, and Compliance
items.summary: Federal Aviation Administration (FAA)-certificated pilot schools are regulated in accordance with Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) part 141.

items.title: Standardized Curricula Delivered by Part 142 Training Centers
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) introduces the standardized curriculum concept for Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) part 135 training provided by 14 CFR part 142 training centers and describes the associated benefits of this voluntary approach.

items.title: Repair Station Limited Ratings Beech 18 Series Aircraft
items.summary: Advises of a required limited repair station rating to perform X-ray inspection of the Beech 18 wing and center section spar, and of the procedures for application.

items.title: Inspection, Retread, Repair, and Alterations of Aircraft Tires - Including Change 2
items.summary: This AC describes methods the Administrator accepts per Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) parts 21, 23, 25, 27, 29, 43, and 145 for the development, qualification, and approval of bias and radial aircraft tire retreads, their repair and process specifications, and the use of special nondestructive inspection (NDI) techniques.

items.title: Repair Station Internal Evaluation Programs - with Change 1
items.summary: Provides information and guidance material that may be used by repair station certificate holders, operating under FAR Part 145, to design and implement an Internal Evaluation Program.

items.title: Guide for Developing and Evaluating Repair Station and Quality Control Manuals
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides informational material for all repair station certificate holders and/or applicants under Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) part 145 to develop and evaluate a Repair Station Manual (RSM) and Quality Control Manual (QCM).

items.title: Repair Station Training Program w/ Change 1
items.summary: Provides information on developing the repair station employee training program required under 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) part 145, section 145, 163, categories of training, training program components, and sample training programs.

items.title: Certification and Operation of Aviation Maintenance Technician Schools
items.summary: This AC provides guidance to assist persons in obtaining and maintaining Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) certification of an Aviation Maintenance Technician School (AMTS).

items.title: Guidelines for Sound Insulation of Structures Exposed to Aircraft Noise
items.summary: This AC provides guidelines to develop and implement a sound insulation program (SIP).

items.title: Announcement Of Availability: RTCA Inc., Document RTCA-221
items.summary: Announces the availability of RTCA, Inc., Document RTCA/DO-221, Guidance and Recommended Requirements for Airport Surface Movement Sensors, dated April 24, 1994.

items.title: Announcement of Availability of Airport-Related Research and Development Products
items.summary: This AC explains how to obtain the latest airport-related research and development (R&D) products funded by the Federal Aviation Administration’s (FAA’s) Airports Organization, particularly the FAA’s Airport Technology Research and Development Branch, the Airport Cooperative Research Program (ACRP), the Innovative Pavement Research Foundation (IPRF), and the Airfield Asphalt Pavement Technology Program (AAPTP).

items.title: Announcement of Availability of the Guide for Private Flyers - U.S. International Airports
items.summary: Announces the availability of the Guide for Private Flyers published by the Department of Homeland Security, U.S.

items.title: Critical Aircraft and Regular Use Determination
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) defines the term Critical Aircraft and provides guidance on the use of Critical Aircraft in facility planning and design studies, and related FAA decision making, for federally obligated airports.

items.title: Noise Control and Compatibility Planning for Airports
items.summary: Provides general guidance for noise control and compatibility planning for airports as well as specific guidance for preparation of airport noise exposure maps and airport noise compatibility programs by airport operators for submission under Title 14, Code of Federal Regulations, Part 150, and the Aviation Safety and Noise Abatement Act of 1979.

items.title: Guidance on the Balanced Approach to Noise Management
items.summary: FAA accepts the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) document, Guidance on the Balanced Approach to Aircraft Noise Management, as additional guidance material.

items.title: Community Involvement in Airport Planning
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides information on community/public involvement in airport planning.

items.title: Environmental Management Systems for Airport Sponsors
items.summary: Provides guidance to airport sponsors that develop Environmental Management Systems (EMS). It provides guidance to airport sponsors on the needed parts of an EMS.

items.title: Airport Capacity And Delay
items.summary: Explains how to compute airport capacity and aircraft delay for airport planning and design. Consolidated file contains Changes 1 and 2.

items.title: Airport Master Plans
items.summary: Provides guidance for the preparation of airport master plans that range in size and function from small general aviation to large commercial service facilities.

items.title: The Airport System Planning Process
items.summary: Provides guidance for effective airport system planning. Consolidated file includes Change 1 (dated 1/16/2015).

items.title: Development of State Aviation Standards for Airport Pavement Construction
items.summary: This AC provides guidelines for the development of State Aviation Standards for airport pavement construction at nonprimary public-use airports as well as the use of State Highway Material Specifications for airport pavement construction at nonprimary airports.

items.title: Architectural, Engineering, and Planning Consultant Services for Airport Grant Projects
items.summary: This AC provides guidance for airport sponsors in the selection and engagement of architectural, engineering, and planning consultants.

items.title: Land Acquisition and Relocation Assistance for Airport Improvement Program Assisted Projects (Consolidated through Change 7)
items.summary: Provides guidance to sponsors of airport projects developed under the Airport Improvement Program (AIP) to meet the requirements of the Uniform Relocation Assistance and Real Property Acquisition Policies Act of 1970 (PL 91-646, as amended) and the Regulations of the Office of the Secretary of Transportation, 49 CFR Part 24.

items.title: Guide for Airport Financial Reports Filed by Airport Sponsors
items.summary: Provides airport sponsors with guidance on filing FAA Form 5100-126, Financial Governmental Payment Report, and FAA Form 5100-127, Operating and Financial Summary.

items.title: Guidance on the Extraction of Oil and Gas on Federally Obligated Airports
items.summary: This AC discusses oil and gas development on federally obligated airport land, including any drilling that penetrates the subsurface of airport owned land.

items.title: State Block Grant Program
items.summary: This AC provides guidance for application to and implementation of the State Block Grant Program (SBGP).

items.title: Federal Surplus Personal Property Program for Public Airport Purposes
items.summary: This AC explains to public airport sponsors and other interested parties the Federal Surplus Personal Property Program for Public Airports.

items.title: Airport Land Use Compatibility Planning
items.summary: This AC is intended to help a broad audience understand the effects of land use on the safety and utility of airport operations and identify compatible land use development tools, resources and techniques to protect surrounding communities from adverse effects associated with airport operations.

items.title: Exclusive Rights at Federally-Obligated Airports
items.summary: Provides basic information about the FAA's prohibition on the granting of exclusive rights at federally-obligated airports.

items.title: Minimum Standards for Commercial Aeronautical Activities
items.summary: This AC provides basic information pertaining to FAA recommendations on commercial minimum standards and related policies.

items.title: First Responders’ Responsibility for Protecting Evidence at the Scene of an Aircraft Accident/Incident
items.summary: Furnishes general guidance for airport employees, airport management, and other personnel responsible for aircraft rescue and firefighting (ARFF) operations at the scene of an aircraft accident on the proper preservation of evidence.

items.title: Airport Safety Self-Inspection
items.summary: This AC provides information to airport operators on airport self-inspection programs and identifies the items included in these programs.

items.title: Notice to Air Missions (NOTAMs) for Airport Operators
items.summary: This AC contains standards and guidance for airport operators on the issuance of Notice to Air Missions (NOTAM).

items.title: Announcement Of Availability Of Airport Self-Inspection DVD
items.summary: Announces the availability of the Airport Safety Self-Inspection DVD, which replaces the previously issued videotape.

items.title: Airport Field Condition Assessments and Winter Operations Safety
items.summary: This AC provides guidance to assist airport operators in developing a snow and ice control plan, assessing and reporting airport conditions through the utilization of the Runway Condition Assessment Matrix (RCAM), and establishing snow removal and control procedures.

items.title: Airport Emergency Plan (Consolidated AC includes Change 2)
items.summary: Provides guidance to the airport operator in the development and implementation of an Airport Emergency Plan (AEP).

items.title: Reporting Wildlife Aircraft Strikes
items.summary: This Advisory Circular explains the importance of reporting collisions between aircraft and wildlife, more commonly referred to as wildlife strikes.

items.title: Hazardous Wildlife Attractants on or near Airports
items.summary: This AC provides guidance on certain land uses that have the potential to attract hazardous wildlife on or near public-use airports.

items.title: Construction or Establishment of Landfills Near Public Airports
items.summary: The FAA provides this Advisory Circular for use by persons considering the construction or establishment of a new municipal solid waste landfill (MSWLF) near a public airport.

items.title: Qualifications for Wildlife Biologist Conducting Wildlife Hazard Assessments and Training Curriculums for Airport Personnel Involved in Controlling Wildlife Hazards on Airports
items.summary: This AC describes the qualifications for wildlife biologists who conduct Wildlife Hazard Assessments (WHA) for airports, and it addresses the minimum wildlife hazard management curriculum for the initial and recurrent training of airport personnel who implement Wildlife Hazard Management Plans (WHMPs).

items.title: Safety Management Systems for Airports
items.summary: This AC presents the concepts of a Safety Management System (SMS) and provides detailed guidance about developing and implementing SMS for an airport.

items.title: Protocol for the Conduct and Review of Wildlife Hazard Site Visits, Wildlife Hazard Assessments, and Wildlife Hazard Management Plans
items.summary: For certificated airports, this Advisory Circular (AC) defines the minimum acceptable standards for the conduct and preparation of Wildlife Hazard Site Visits (Site Visit), Wildlife Hazard Assessments (Assessments) and Wildlife Hazard Management Plans (Plans).

items.title: Painting, Marking, and Lighting of Vehicles Used on an Airport
items.summary: Provides guidance, specifications, and standards for painting, marking, and lighting of ground vehicles operating in the airport air operations area (AOA).

items.title: Aircraft Fire Extinguishing Agents for Airports
items.summary: This Advisory Circular provides reference information on Aircraft Fire Extinguishing Agents and provides an acceptable method for complying with Title 14, Code of Federal Regulations, Part 139, Certification of Airports.

items.title: 150/5210-7E, Aircraft Rescue and Fire Fighting Communications
items.summary: This AC provides guidance to assist airport operators in preparing for Aircraft Rescue and Fire Fighting (ARFF) communications.

items.title: Airport Water Rescue Plans and Equipment
items.summary: Provides guidance to assist airport operators in preparing for water rescue operations.

items.title: Aircraft Rescue Fire Fighting Equipment, Tools and Personal Protective Equipment
items.summary: This AC contains references to the minimum standards for the selection and performance of aircraft rescue and firefighting personal protective equipment (PPE), self-contained breathing apparatus (SCBA), and powered rescue tools.

items.title: Aircraft Rescue and Firefighting Station Building Design
items.summary: Contains information, references and guidelines for construction of Aircraft Rescue and Fire Fighting (ARFF) station building design.

items.title: Programs for Training of Aircraft Rescue and Firefighting Personnel
items.summary: This AC provides information on courses and reference materials for training of Aircraft Rescue and Firefighting (ARFF) personnel.

items.title: Systems for Interactive Training Of Airport Personnel
items.summary: Provides guidance in the design of systems for interactive training of airport personnel, which are eligible for funding under the Airport Improvement Program (AIP) and with Passenger Facility Charge (PFC) revenues.

items.title: 150/5210-19B, Driver’s Enhanced Vision System (DEVS)
items.summary: This AC contains performance standards, specifications, and recommendations for Driver’s Enhanced Vision System (DEVS).

items.title: Ground Vehicle Operations to include Taxiing or Towing an Aircraft on Airports
items.summary: This AC and its appendices provide guidance to airport operators about developing training programs for safe ground vehicle operations, personnel taxiing or towing an aircraft, and pedestrian control on the movement and safety areas of an airport.

items.title: Airport Certification Manual (ACM)
items.summary: Provides methods for meeting the certification requirements specified in Title 14, Code of Federal Regulations, Part 139, Certification of Airports.

items.title: ARFF Vehicle and High Reach Extendable Turret (HRET) Operation, Training and Qualifications
items.summary: This AC contains the FAA standards and recommendations for the training of airport firefighting and rescue personnel in the proper operation and tactical use of ARFF vehicles and ARFF Vehicles equipped with HRETs.

items.title: Airport Foreign Object Debris (FOD) Management
items.summary: This AC provides guidance for developing and managing an airport foreign object debris (FOD) program and specifications for the equipment used in FOD removal operations.

items.title: Performance Specification for Airport Vehicle Runway Incursion Warning Systems (RIWS)
items.summary: This AC provides a performance specification for an airport vehicle runway incursion warning system (RIWS).

items.title: Aircraft Arresting Systems on Civil Airports
items.summary: This AC contains the FAA standards and recommendations for the installations of aircraft arresting systems on civil airports not owned or operated by the U.S.

items.title: Guide Specification for Aircraft Rescue and Fire Fighting (ARFF) Vehicles
items.summary: This advisory circular provides guidance for preparing a specification that airports can use in procuring Aircraft Rescue and Fire Fighting (ARFF) vehicles.

items.title: Automated Weather Observing Systems (AWOS) for Non-Federal Applications - with Change 1
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) contains the Federal Aviation Administration’s (FAA) standard for the non-Federal AWOS.

items.title: Aircraft Rescue and Fire Fighting (ARFF) Training Facilities
items.summary: Provides guidance on the design, construction, and operation of aircraft rescue and fire fighting (ARFF) training facilities.

items.title: Buildings for Storage and Maintenance of Airport Snow and Ice Control Equipment and Materials
items.summary: Provides guidance for the site selection and design of buildings used to store and maintain airport snow and ice control equipment, store approved materials, and provide personnel areas required to support the requirements under the airport operator’s winter storm management plan.

items.title: Airport Snow and Ice Control Equipment
items.summary: This advisory circular provides guidance to assist airport operators in the procurement of snow and ice control equipment for airport use.

items.title: Aircraft Boarding Equipment
items.summary: Contains the FAA's performance standards, specifications, and recommendations for the design, manufacture, testing and maintenance of equipment used in the boarding of airline passengers.

items.title: Engineered Materials Arresting Systems (EMAS) for Aircraft Overruns
items.summary: Contains standards for the planning, design, installation, and maintenance of Engineered Materials Arresting Systems (EMAS) in runway safety areas (RSAs).

items.title: Frangible Connections
items.summary: This advisory circular contains standards and guidelines for the frangible connections used to support objects located in airfield safety areas and object free areas.

items.title: Foreign Object Debris Detection Equipment
items.summary: Provides information that airports can use to procure foreign object debris (FOD) detection equipment.

items.title: Airport Avian Radar Systems
items.summary: Provides guidance on the use of avian radar systems to supplement an airport’s Wildlife Hazard Management Plan (WHMP) and reduce the potential avian threats to aircraft.

items.title: Airport Ground Vehicle Automatic Dependent Surveillance - Broadcast (ADS-B) Out Squitter Equipment
items.summary: Provides guidance on the development, installation, testing, approval, and maintenance of ADS-B Out squitter units for airport ground vehicles.

items.title: Aircraft Fuel Storage, Handling, and Dispensing on Airports
items.summary: This AC contains specifications and guidance for the storage, handling, and dispensing of aviation fuel on airports.

items.title: FAA Policy on Facility Relocations Occasioned by Airport Improvements or Changes
items.summary: Reaffirms to the aviation community the FAA policy governing responsibility for funding relocation, replacement and modification of air traffic control and air navigation facilities that are made necessary by improvements or changes to the airport.

items.title: Airport Design - Change 1
items.summary: This AC contains the Federal Aviation Administration’s (FAA) standards and recommendations for the geometric layout and engineering design of runways, taxiways, aprons, and other facilities at civil airports.

items.title: Design of Aircraft Deicing Facilities
items.summary: This AC provides standards and guidance for designing aircraft deicing facilities.

items.title: Use Of Value Engineering For Engineering And Design Of Airport Grant Projects
items.summary: Provides guidance on using value engineering (VE) in airport projects funded under the Federal Aviation Administration's (FAA's) Airport Grant program.

items.title: General Guidance and Specifications for Aeronautical Surveys: Establishment of Geodetic Control and Submission to the National Geodetic Survey
items.summary: This AC explains the specifications for establishing geodetic control on or near an airport.

items.summary: Provides guidance on the use of remote sensing technologies in the collection of data describing the physical infrastructure of an airport.

items.summary: Provides the specifications for the collection of airport data for the FAA Airport Surveying – Geographic Information System (GIS) Program.

items.title: Airport Data and Information Program
items.summary: This AC provides general guidance and information for airport owners and operators in the collection and management of data describing the physical infrastructure, characteristics, and services of their airport.

items.title: Submission of On-Airport Proposals for Aeronautical Study
items.summary: This AC provides guidance on submitting accurate, complete on-airport proposals so the FAA can conduct an aeronautical study.

items.title: Airport Drainage Design
items.summary: This AC provides guidance for engineers, airport managers, and the public about the design and construction of airport surface storm drainage systems; and subsurface drainage systems for paved runways, taxiways, and aprons.

items.summary: This AC provides guidance to the public on the design and evaluation of pavements used by aircraft at civil airports.

items.summary: Contains guidelines and procedures for the design and construction of skid-resistant pavement; pavement evaluation, without or with friction equipment; and maintenance of high skid-resistant pavements.

items.summary: This AC provides limited guidance on understanding and rating the surface condition of flexible (asphalt) and rigid (concrete) airfield pavements.

items.summary: Provides design standards and guidelines for determining recommended runway lengths.

items.summary: This AC provides guidance for using the standardized International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) method, called the Aircraft Classification Rating – Pavement Classification Rating (ACR-PCR) method, to report airport runway, taxiway, and apron pavement strength.

items.title: Standards for Airport Markings
items.summary: This AC contains the FAA standards for markings used on airport runways, taxiways, and aprons. Consolidated to include Change 1, dated December 23, 2020.

items.title: Segmented Circle Airport Marker System
items.summary: This AC provides standards for a system of airport marking consisting of certain pilot aids and traffic control devices.

items.title: Standards for Airport Sign Systems
items.summary: This Advisory Circular (AC) contains the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) standards for the siting, design, and installation of signs on airport runways and taxiways.

items.title: Maintenance of Airport Visual Aid Facilities
items.summary: This AC provides guidance and specifications for the Maintenance of airport Visual Aid Facilities.

items.title: Design and Installation Details for Airport Visual Aids
items.summary: This AC provides guidance and recommendations on the installation of airport visual aids. See the Principal Changes paragraph for a list of major changes to the document since the last version.

items.title: Specification for L-821, Panels for the Control of Airport Lighting
items.summary: Provides the specified manufacturing requirements for panels used for remote control of airport lighting and auxiliary systems.

items.title: Circuit Selector Switch
items.summary: Contains a specification for a circuit selector switch for use in airport lighting circuits.

items.title: Specification for L-824 Underground Electrical Cable for Airport Lighting Circuits
items.summary: This AC provides specifications for L-824 underground electrical cable for airport lighting circuits.

items.summary: Contains a specification for constant current regulators (CCR) and a monitor for use with airport lighting circuits.

items.summary: Contains equipment specifications for light beacons that are used to locate and identify civil airports, military airports, seaplane bases, and heliports.

items.title: Specification for L-841 Auxiliary Relay Cabinet Assembly for Pilot Control of Airport Lighting Circuits
items.summary: Contains the specification requirements for a relay cabinet used to control airfield lighting circuits.

items.summary: This AC contains the specification for plug and receptacle (cable connectors) used with underground power cables, isolation transformer leads, and light fixture leads for airport lighting systems.

items.summary: This AC contains a specification for wind cone assemblies to be used to provide wind information to pilots of aircraft.

items.title: Precision Approach Path Indicator (PAPI) Systems

items.title: Specification for L-853, Runway and Taxiway Retroreflective Markers
items.summary: This AC contains the FAA's standards for retroreflective markers for airport runways and taxiways.

items.title: Specification for Airport Light Bases, Transformer Housings, Junction Boxes, and Accessories
items.summary: This advisory circular contains the specifications for airport light bases, transformer housings, junction boxes, accessories, and elevated light fixture covers and stakes.

items.title: Specification for Obstruction Lighting Equipment
items.summary: This AC contains the FAA specification for obstruction lighting equipment.

items.title: Specification for Runway and Taxiway Signs
items.summary: This advisory circular contains the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) specifications for unlighted and lighted signs to be used on taxiways and runways.

items.title: Low-Impact Resistant (LIR) Structures

items.title: Specification for Runway, Taxiway, Heliport, and Vertiport Light Fixtures
items.summary: This advisory circular contains the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) specifications for light fixtures to be used on airport runways and taxiways.

items.title: Specification for Series to Series Isolation Transformers for Airport Lighting Systems
items.summary: Contains the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) specifications for series to series isolation transformers for use in airport lighting systems.

items.title: Specification L-854, Radio Control Equipment
items.summary: This AC contains the specifications for radio control equipment to be used for controlling airport lighting facilities.

items.summary: Contains the specifications for discharge-type flashing light equipment to be used for runway end identification lights (REIL) and for an omni-directional approach lighting system (ODALS).

items.summary: Contains the FAA standards for generic visual glideslope indicators systems. GVGI systems provide pilots with visual glideslope guidance during approaches for landing at general aviation airports.

items.title: Specification for L-884, Power and Control Unit for Land and Hold Short Lighting Systems
items.summary: Contains the FAA standards for power and control units for land and hold short lighting systems.

items.title: Specification for L-893, Lighted Visual Aid to Indicate Temporary Runway Closure
items.summary: Provides guidance in the design of a lighted visual aid to indicate temporary runway closure.

items.title: Specification for L-890 Airport Lighting Control and Monitoring System (ALCMS)
items.summary: Specifies the minimum requirements for an Airport Lighting Control and Monitoring System (ALCMS).

items.title: Access to Airports by Individuals with Disabilities

items.title: Operational Safety on Airports During Construction

items.summary: The standard specifications contained in this advisory circular (AC) relate to materials and methods used for construction on airports.

items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides information on the planning and oversight of construction projects at airports accomplished under the FAA's Airport Improvement Program (AIP).

items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides a high-level overview of the Federal Aviation Administration’s (FAA) Non-federal Program policy for establishing, owning, operating, and maintaining a non-federal system/service in the National Airspace System (NAS).

items.title: Flight Standards Service Schedule of Charges Outside the United States
items.summary: This AC transmits an updated schedule of charges for services of Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Flight Standards Service (FS) aviation safety inspectors (ASI) outside the United States.

items.title: Aircraft Certification Service Fees for Providing Production Certification-Related Services Outside the United States
items.summary: Official FAA advisory circular: Aircraft Certification Service Fees for Providing Production Certification-Related Services Outside the United States.

items.title: Powered-Lift Operations
items.summary: This AC describes how powered-lift will comply with specific regulations in 14 CFR parts 43, 91, 91 subpart K (part 91K), 97, 135, and 136.

items.title: Pilot Training and Certification for Powered-Lift Operations
items.summary: This AC provides guidance for applicants, pilots, evaluators, and instructors who seek to add an initial powered-lift category rating and specific type rating to their existing United States (U.S.) pilot certificate in accordance with Special Federal Aviation Regulation (SFAR) 120, Powered-Lift: Pilot Certification and Training; Operations Requirements.

items.title: Military Flying Activities
items.summary: Provides information about military flying activities in the National Airspace System, describes the various types of routes and areas allocated for this purpose, and explains how information on the location and status of these routes and areas can be obtained.

items.title: Guidance on Submitting a Complete Enough and Complete Application for a Vehicle Operator License
items.summary: This Advisory Circular (AC) provides guidance on demonstrating compliance with the requirements of completing a license application in accordance with Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (CFR) §§ 413.11 and 413.13.

items.title: Reusable Launch and Reentry Vehicle System Safety Process
items.summary: Provides guidance and information concerning the application of a systematic and logical system safety process and methodology for identification and control of public safety hazards associated with the operation of reusable launch vehicle and reentry vehicle systems.

items.title: Hazard Analysis for the Launch or Reentry of a Reusable Suborbital Rocket Under an Experimental Permit
items.summary: Provide guidance for applying a systematic and logical hazard analysis to the identification, analysis, and control of public safety hazards and risks associated with the launch and reentry of a reusable suborbital rocket under an experimental permit.

items.title: Anomaly Reporting and Corrective Action for a Reusable Suborbital Rocket Operating Under an Experimental Permit
items.summary: Provide guidance for reporting anomalie occurring in reusable suborbital rockets operating under an expermentalpermit issued by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) This AC also provide guidance for implementing an anomaly reporting and corrective action system for reusable suborbital rockets operating under FAA-issued experimental permit.

items.title: Reciprocal Waiver of Claims Requirements
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides guidance for an operator to comply with Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) § 440.17 Reciprocal waiver of claims requirements by providing templates for reciprocal waiver of claims agreements that are in a form acceptable to the Administrator.

items.title: Definition of Launch and Scope of a Vehicle Operator License
items.summary: This Advisory Circular (AC) provides guidance on the Federal Aviation Administration’s (FAA) definition of “launch” in § 401.7, and the determination of the beginning of a launch at a United States (U.S.) launch site, per § 450.3(b)(1) and (d).

items.title: Applying for FAA Determination on Policy or Payload Reviews
items.summary: This AC provides guidance on demonstrating compliance with the requirements for policy and payload reviews in accordance with Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) § 450.31.

items.title: Launch and Reentry of Space Nuclear Systems
items.summary: The purpose of this AC is to guide applicants through the launch and reentry licensing process when SNS are present on a launch or reentry vehicle.

items.title: Compliance when Contracting with a Federal Entity
items.summary: This Advisory Circular (AC) offers guidance for demonstrating compliance with title 14 Code of Federal Regulations (CFR) part 450 requirements by using services or property of a Federal launch or reentry site or other Federal Entity by contract.

items.title: High Consequence Event Protection
items.summary: This Advisory Circular (AC) describes a method to demonstrate compliance with the high consequence event protection requirements of title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) § 450.101(c) and the requirements to evaluate the potential for high consequence events in uncontrolled areas in accordance with §§ 450.108(b) and 450.108(c)(4).

items.title: System Safety Program
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides guidance and an acceptable method, but not the only method, that may be used to define an acceptable system safety program (SSP) in accordance with Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) § 450.103 System Safety Program.

items.title: Hazard Control Strategies Determination
items.summary: This Advisory Circular (AC) provides guidance for an applicant to determine its hazard control strategy or strategies in accordance with Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) § 450.107(b).

items.title: Flight Abort Rule Development
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides guidance and a comprehensive method to demonstrate compliance with the requirements for the flight abort hazard control strategy in § 450.108, Flight Abort.

items.title: Flight Hazard Analysis
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides guidance for an operator to apply a systematic and logical hazard analysis to identify, analyze, and control public safety hazards and risks associated with flight, and phases of flight, for a launch or reentry vehicle (hereafter referred to as system) in accordance with § 450.109.

items.title: Physical Containment as a Hazard Control Strategy
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides guidance for an operator to develop a physical containment analysis in accordance with § 450.110.

items.title: High Fidelity Flight Safety Analysis
items.summary: This Advisory Circular (AC) provides guidance and a comprehensive method for performing a high fidelity flight safety analysis in accordance with title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) § 450.115.

items.title: Describing Flight Safety Analysis Methods
items.summary: This Advisory Circular (AC) provides guidance for documenting and submitting a description of the methods used in a Flight Safety Analysis (FSA) in accordance with title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) § 450.115(c).

items.title: Trajectory Analysis for Normal Flight
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides guidance and a comprehensive method for performing a normal trajectory analysis in accordance with § 450.117 of title 14, Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR).

items.title: Population Exposure Analysis
items.summary: This Advisory Circular (AC) provides guidance and methods for performing a population exposure analysis in accordance with Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) 450.123.

items.title: De Minimis Far-Field Overpressure Blast Effects Analysis
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides guidance on a simplified method for performing a Far-Field Blast Overpressure (FFBO) effects analysis as part of a flight safety analysis in accordance with 14 CFR § 450.137.

items.title: Toxic Hazards
items.summary: This AC provides guidance for an operator conducting a licensed launch or reentry under 14 CFR part 450.

items.title: Computing System Safety
items.summary: This Advisory Circular (AC) provides guidance for identifying computing system safety items, developing safety requirements for each computing system safety item, and mitigating the risks presented by computing system safety items, in accordance with 14 CFR § 450.141.

items.title: Control of Hazard Areas
items.summary: This AC provides guidance on meeting the requirements of § 450.161 to publicize, survey, control, or evacuate each flight hazard area identified under § 450.133 prior to initiating flight of a launch vehicle or the reentry of a reentry vehicle to the extent necessary to ensure compliance with the risk criteria in § 450.101.

items.title: Tracking for Launch and Reentry Safety Analysis
items.summary: This AC provides guidance and an acceptable means of complying with the requirement to track the flight of a launch or reentry vehicle under 14 CFR § 450.167 using onboard hardware, launch site services, or other means.

items.title: Launch and Reentry Collision Avoidance Analysis
items.summary: This AC provides guidance to launch or reentry operators on how to complete the launch and reentry collision avoidance analysis in accordance with 14 CFR § 450.169.

items.title: Part 450 Mishap Plan – Reporting, Response, and Investigation Requirements
items.summary: This Advisory Circular (AC) provides guidance and an acceptable method, but not the only method, for developing a mishap plan under title 14 CFR § 450.173.

items.title: Ground Safety
items.summary: This Advisory Circular (AC) provides guidance and a comprehensive method for performing a ground safety analysis in accordance with title 14, Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) §§ 450.179, 450.181, 450.183, 450.185, and 450.189.

items.title: Human Factors Considerations in Commercial Human Space Flight
items.summary: This advisory circular (AC) provides guidance and an acceptable method, but not the only method, that may be used to account for human factors when crew must perform safety critical roles in accordance with Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) § 460.15.

items.title: United States Air Force Terminal Instrument Procedures Service
items.summary: This order provides guidance to all personnel in the administration of the Flight Procedures and Airspace Program.
